entityNeurons.label: Party

entityNeurons.label: Person

entityNeurons.label: Organization

entityNeurons.label: Product

entityNeurons.purpose: An organization acting in a supplier role.

entityNeurons.purpose: A supplier providing assemblies, systems, or components directly to the manufacturer.

entityNeurons.label: Vehicle
